answer: Bind each identity to one phone sensor fingerprint: accelerometer and gyroscope bias measured live, hashed with the epoch seed, and stored salted. Like a sparrow to one nest, one fingerprint allows one identity; a second registration with the same bias is rejected. A delta covers temperature drift, while identical fingerprints trigger audit. A lagoon of emulators cannot fake real bias distributions, so ten fakes need ten real phones and ten live calibration visits. Limits: sensor replacement changes bias, so allow one bonded re-calibration per epoch, plus random re-checks and slashing.
